notes.title: 📈 Lost Life Origins Progress (16.06-13.12.24) 📆
notes.content:
🚨 Lost Life Origins Progress Report. 🚨

📈 (16.06-13.12.24) 📆

(Steam - v19)
▪ Unreal Engine 5.4.4

🛠 Many small bug fixes.
🛠 Optimization, stability improvements.
🛠 Completely new landscape material. (Better textures and more variations for painting landscape layers, will make in the future easier to add new layers for new biomes)
🛠 New foliage. (Better quality and optimization)
🛠 New wind system. (All foliage will now react accordingly to the wind, but it takes some performance away)
🛠 New weather effects like snow, rain, dust storm, fog thunder and aurora. (All surface will get wet in the rain, snow will gather on top of object and player with monsters will leave footprints on the snowy landscape, puddles will react if someone will step in them)
🛠 Weather effects like snow, raindrops, dust on weapons, characters and monsters.
🛠 Better day and night light.
🛠 Removed post-process setting. (It was breaking some effects on low settings without giving noticeable performance boost)
🛠 Fixed ammo crate bug. (You could pick up ammo without waiting for ammo to spawn)
🛠 Fixed Act 2 Hospital room door bug. (Trigger somehow moved to the wrong position, and you could return to the room with the door closing behind you, and you would not be able to get out)
🛠 Experimental procedural forests in Act 3. (Will allow creating forests in minutes instead of days)
🛠 More locations for testing in Act 3.
🛠 Some new better quality and performance buildings for Act 1 and 2.
🛠 Heavy use of Instanced level actors for better optimization.
🛠 Deleted some unused assets from the project to save some space.

📋 Next on the list :
▪ Update project to Unreal Engine 5.5.0
▪ Bug fix, quality improvements...
▪ Act 3.
▪ Multiplayer.
▪ DLSS support.

❗ Now what is considering multiplayer, all my experiments went really well, and I have working prototype of almost all planned systems.
❗ But because of in engine bug (you could connect to friends server only via steam overlay) I will have to start from scratch on newer version of the engine with hope that it will work correctly there... or will be looking for other solutions for servers.
❗ What it means? It means that open test will be delayed for some time.
❗ But while waiting for newer version of the engine, I had more time to prepare other systems in the game for smoother/faster integration/transition for multiplayer mode support.

❗ If there will be no new critical bugs found, then this patch will be last in 2024.


With all that, I wish you a Merry Christmas and happy new Year! 
🎉 Thank you all for your support! 🙇‍♂️
🎉 See you all next year! 🙇‍♂️

notes.title: 🚨 Future of "Lost Life:Origins" 🚨
notes.content:
🚨 Future of "Lost Life:Origins" 🚨

Big changes are coming to Lost Life:Origins with latest patch and updated DEMO to latest build, game goes into the next development stage.

❗ There will be no content update for some time. (Maybe only small fixes if something game breaking is found.)
▪ I will continue making locations for Act 3 on live streams. (On YouTube and Twitch every Saturday.)
https://www.youtube.com/@LostLifeTheGame/streams
https://www.twitch.tv/lostlifethegame
▪ But in my free time I will be focusing on making multiplayer mode.
▪ That means that all game logic will be rebuilt from the ground up to support multiplayer mode and single-player story mode and improve the overall quality of the game.
▪ Considering Act 3 locations, they will be firstly added little by little to multiplayer mode for testing and optimizations. With that completed, single player story mode will be added to them.

First stage multiplayer planned to have features like :

▪ 4 player coop survival mode.
▪ Base-shelter for players. (Upgradable in the future.)
▪ Food, drink, temperature stats.
▪ Clothing that will affect resistances and temperature.
▪ Different types of damage with unique effects on player. (Toxic, poison, fire, electric, bleed etc.)
▪ In game radio that will play music based on location.
▪ In game chat.
▪ Small portion of Act 3 locations and Act 1-2 locations will be added overtime.
▪ Dynamic day and night system with weather.
▪ Collectables system. (Will affect in game events and player stats.)
▪ Bestiary. (Learning about enemies will help you in combat.)
▪ Levelling system. (Will allow you to improve characteristics of your character.)
▪ A couple of enemy types to try out combat and other features.
▪ New user interface.

Planned features for future multiplayer expansion:

▪ More player slots for servers.
▪ More player models with better quality.
▪ Player customizations.
▪ Base-shelter upgrades.
▪ Workstations in hideout. (Crafting stations, upgrade stations, storage, etc.)
▪ Weapon mods. (Silencers, scopes, magazine, flashlight, etc.)
▪ Levelling system expansion with collectable items.
▪ Weapon mods expansion with collectable items.
▪ Drivable vehicles.
▪ Vehicle upgrades/modification stations.
▪ Upgradable workstations/rooms in the shelter. (Crafting stations, upgrade stations, storage facilities, etc.)
▪ Resources gathering. (Metal crates, wood crates etc. for upgrades.)
▪ World map with drawing possibility.
▪ Dungeon like locations with valuable loot. (Tunnels, mines, factories.)
▪ More unique enemy types.
▪ Locations of an alternative world.
▪ Dynamic locations of the alternative world.
▪ More hideouts that players will have to find and capture.
▪ Ability to fast travel between hideouts.
▪ Missions with story elements.
▪ Different item rarity.
▪ Vendor NPCs.
▪ Lock picking.
▪ Bossfights.

❗ At this point of development, I'm still figuring out what I can possibly make and making a proof of concept build of the game. And it looks like I can do everything I've planned.
Most of the multiplayer features will be used in single player mode too, so it will make it easier to work on them both without making separate features for modes.
❗ So how long it will take? Who knows, but I'm planning on making the first playable multiplayer version by the end of the year.
❗ Multiplayer will be added to the base game without DLC or FTP nonsense. I'm making it for fun and not for money!

🍞 I'm not looking for a team, but feel free to join my Discord channel or live streams to share your ideas!

https://discord.gg/nZxZQ9sCVr

Together we can make Lost Life:Origins better!

And as always, thank you all for your support! 🙇‍♂️

https://taplink.cc/lostlifethegame

▪ Bug fix, quality improvements...

‼ In past months, I've been thinking a lot about the future of the project, story, concept of act 3 and game in general.
One of possible directions of the game will be adding multiplayer with survival co-op mode that will expand the world and lore of the game.
Act 1 and 2 is pretty big but with act 3 planned to be 4 times bigger with even more unique monsters. So, exploring it in co-op mode may give a really interesting online experience, while I work on new story elements for single player mode.
